title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud

meta.Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was so good!
Ahh, I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, what should we do about practice this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we haven't set a meeting time yet, have we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We have the studio from two...
So, why don't we meet up a bit early and have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm sorry.
I might actually arrive late.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My neighborhood association is getting together that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your neighborhood association...?
They put on seasonal events and stuff, right? Locally organized cherry blossom viewing parties immediately come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, they also put on hiking events and fun festivals!
No fair! I wanna join!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I won't be participating in an event this time around. I'll be representing my parents at an association meeting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna be in a meeting?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, this isn't the first time you've done this for them, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I only do this on occasion. Usually during the periods when our shop is at its busiest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you get to speak for your mom and dad!
You're such a grown-up, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what are you going to discuss at this meeting?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This time, we'll be discussing a picture-book reading.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A picture-book reading...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember how you read me all those stories when we were little and I was still in the hospital, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You always put such a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I also had fun watching your eyes twinkle each time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does this mean you're gonna be the one telling stories, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, our veteran storyteller will be handling that. I'll probably be helping out behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You seem really excited about this, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? D-Do I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, the way you're smiling says it all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually attended one of these readings before when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was where I learned about this story I really love, and they're going to be telling it during this event.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So that's why you're so excited♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to this event so much.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll need to do everything I can in order to make it a great one.)
A few days later
Community Center

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Thank you all for taking time out of your busy schedules to gather here today.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: About the reading event we'll be holding next month... We've run into a slight problem, and I'd like to discuss it with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A problem? What happened...?)

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Endo, our designated storyteller, likely won't be able to join us for this event...

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: So, we'll need to make an emergency swap.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: I'd like to begin by asking for volunteers. Would any of you care to be our storyteller?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To be the storyteller...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I did tell a few stories when I went to shadow over at that kindergarten, but this event is on a completely different scale...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually attended one of these readings before when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was where I learned about this story I really love, and they're going to be telling it during this event.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If it's alright, I'd like to volunteer!
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Phew...
Why don't we take a quick break here?
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
We seem to be doing a much better job staying in rhythm during the chorus after you worked with us individually, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
I brought apple pies to have as snacks, so would you all like some?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That'd be lovely.
I was just craving something sweet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also brought hot tea in my thermos.
Please have some if you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means we get to have a little tea party.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That reminds me. Saki and the others told me that you'd be reading a picture book for an event, Honami. Is that true...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
It's an event that my neighborhood puts on regularly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you get to read that story you really love, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I'm a little worried that I won't be able to do it justice... But I'm also really excited.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, that's wonderful!
Can you tell me more about this story?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I've been meaning to ask that as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... I thought I put it in my bag so I could practice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, here. It's this story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “The Star-Chasing Dog”...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is this dog on the cover the titular character?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. The story begins with him living a happy life with his owner, an ever-so-kind boy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But one day, the boy becomes desperately ill.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the doctor notifies his family that there is no treatment available.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, in order to save the boy, the dog sets out on a journey all on his own to find a star which grants wishes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All on his own...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He must be so worried about his owner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
And during his travels, he encounters people with wishes of their own...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As the story progresses, he decides to help them out one by one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because he believes that's what his beloved owner would do...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what happens at the end?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He unfortunately fails to find a wish-granting star.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But all the people he helped decide to come together and repay the kindness he showed to them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And they ultimately find just the medicine the boy needed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A happy ending.
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was a little worried there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I felt the same way when I heard this for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This dog actually didn't feel all that brave in the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But he worked up the courage to set out on a journey to save his owner, and even helped those he encountered along the way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I really love this dog's kind heart...
Which is why I found myself cheering for him the whole time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This dog sort of reminds me of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's uncanny, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We're not talking about his appearance.
We're talking about the way you both work very hard for the sake of others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
Every time you decide to help somebody, Honami, you always go above and beyond.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which probably comes from this powerful desire within you to help others out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly.
And you're incredibly kind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I never thought about it that way...
But I really appreciate you two saying that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Honami, does this book belong to you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, my parents bought it for me after I told them just how much I loved it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it.
That explains all the cute stickers on the back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
You made a star-studded sky.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes... When I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had this habit of putting stickers on all my favorite things back then... And I think I wanted to give this dog the star he deserved...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha. Now I'm a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't be embarrassed, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually really like these stickers.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because it's a great expression of just how much you love this book.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I have to think that the dog in this story can't get enough of these star stickers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
Would it be alright if I snuck over to watch you read this story at the event?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If it really does mean that much to you, then I'd love to see how you present it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course, I'll make sure to stay hidden from everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, in that case, you're more than welcome to come watch the event, as well as my practices.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm really looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope your event goes well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I'll work hard to make sure all the children go home smiling.
The next day
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “After the dog decided to go on his journey, he told the boy this as he lay in his bed.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Just wait.
I promise to find a star that will grant my wish.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And we'll go to that big field again after you get better. We can spend the entire day in the sun playing tag.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “So, just wait...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can read it without stuttering or hesitating now... But I don't feel that I've become all that skilled.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing and get better at this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Around twenty first and second graders are supposed to join us for this event.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Are there any special considerations that I need to keep in mind when reading to small children?)
Thanks for having me over!

rows.Speaker: Haru's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, wait! You gotta wash your hands first!

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend's Voice
rows.Line: Okay, okay! Where's the bathroom?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right.
Haru said he'd be bringing his friend over today.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's it!
Mochizuki Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What did you two think...?

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line: That was great!

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
Yeah, it wasn't bad.
But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
Hmm... You're too relaxed, you know...?
You said you're gonna be reading to first and second graders, right?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: It's a pretty long story, so some of them might get bored partway through and start fooling around.

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
The first graders never sit still during assemblies and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: G-Good point...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I ended up listening very intently because I'd fallen completely in love with this story. But not everyone is going to respond the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I'm still a novice in terms of storytelling...)

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: Also, some kids might not actually like these kinds of stories. What if their parents are making them be there?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: You're gonna have to try really hard to keep their attention. To be honest, you're so nice that some kids probably won't take you seriously.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line: Whoa, that's pretty harsh. She's your big sister. Are you going through a rebellious phase or something?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
If I don't give it to her straight now, she might end up paying for it later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
He's right...
I really appreciate the advice, you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try seeing what I can do to sound more captivating. Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: Hm? You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep on practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, what was the reading I went to like...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I remember the characters really coming to life. It was almost as if I got to be a part of the story... Oh...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That's it...
By improving my voice acting skills, I might be able to keep the children from getting bored.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll start by looking into that.
A few hours later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (“Fundamental Vocal Projection Exercises”, “Want To Become A Famous Voice Actor? Here's How”, “Modern Acting Methods”... So many books on the subject.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I came to see if they had any that would help with voice acting, but I'm not sure where I'm supposed to start now...)
Huh? Mochizuki...?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uhh, hi...
Is this a bad time? Do you need a rain check?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I saw you standing in front of this bookshelf looking kind of troubled. Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you worry or anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The thing is, my neighborhood is holding...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. And you're here to find a good book on voice acting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm a complete novice, so I felt that I should learn from a reputable source instead of going it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, now I don't even know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Voice acting does involve a lot of different things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's all these facets to it, like different acting and practice methods...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just trying to remember if I have any books that you could use...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But most use really technical language, which might end up confusing you even further...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to try and help me, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, you don't need to thank me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If anything, Mochizuki, you're the one who's always helping me out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only did you teach me how to make scented candles, you even lent a hand during Shibu Schools Fest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'd like to take this opportunity to repay the favor somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, I should be able to help at least somewhat when it comes to acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can I ask you to be my acting coach?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. If it isn't too much trouble, I'd love to get whatever advice I can from you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do what I can...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much.
A few days later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Just wait.
I promise to find a star that will grant my wish.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
I really like the way you said that just now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You made this dog sound so kind. The way he comforted the boy felt so genuine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This dog really reminds me of you, Mochizuki.
I feel like your voice is perfect for him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what MEI...
I mean, that's what Ichika and the others told me. This dog also reminded them of me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see why.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After actually giving it a try, I realized how difficult this really is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'd probably still be lost if you hadn't agreed to coach me, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're saying that, since I'm no voice acting expert myself. I'm honestly stumbling around in the dark a bit here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You gave me a wonderful explanation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I have a lot to learn since my acting skills are still quite poor...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I plan on doing my best to make sure all those children go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I wouldn't expect anything less from you, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because you're always working for the sake of others. Whenever you see someone in need, you never hesitate to jump in and help them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, my primary goal is to make sure the children enjoy this story...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that isn't actually the reason I decided to do this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It isn't?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I've never forgotten how moved I was when I had this story read to me for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember being so worried when the dog decided to set out on his journey to save the boy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And by the time he did save the boy, I was bawling my eyes out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see.
In other words, this story means just that much to you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It does. I quickly fell in love with picture books, and I discovered many more wonderful stories soon after.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like the children to experience the same thing I did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember being really moved by this show I saw when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I first fell in love with shows, and I subsequently fell in love with singing and acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At first, I simply wanted to become just like the lead actress I saw on stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But as time went on, that feeling transformed into a desire to make others feel that same sense of exhilaration.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, that's basically what you just said.
So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like we're in the same boat here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In that case...
I don't know if you'd be okay with it, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it possible for people from outside your neighborhood to help with this event?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like taking part now after hearing your story, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! Having you there would make me feel so much better, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll need to ask the association for permission, but it shouldn't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we'll both be reading, should we divide up the roles between us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, if you wanna do that, then I have a suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think you should play the dog, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you want me playing the lead...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I know it won't be easy because there are so many lines, but I really do think your gentle voice fits the bill...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, I'll do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll also help out however I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start dividing up the other roles.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I look forward to working with you on this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...
A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
Which is why you'd like me to come up with a few simple effects for this story, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sorry. I know this is very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After discussing this matter with Kusanagi, we realized that we need to take other things into consideration besides our acting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A lot of children are going to be present, and some may not actually be fans of these kinds of stories... So, I thought we should come prepared from as many angles as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they could prove to be quite a handful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be more than happy to lend a hand since I don't see myself getting many other opportunities to direct reading events.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But don't get too ahead of yourself, Rui.
This is just a plain old reading event.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No cannons or anything crazy like that, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: C-Cannons...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's unfortunate.
I figured that a small bolt of lightning would be an excellent way to gather the children's attention.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, that'd be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know.
This story has a gentle quality to it, so I'll come up with ideas which complement that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on what you just said, there are going to be quite a few children there. Is the story by chance going to be presented on a projector?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, that's right.
We'll have a screen set up on the stage in the gymnasium.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In other words, you have quite a lot of space to work with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As an example... There's that scene where the dog ventures through a snowy field. What if we make it snow as you read that part?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Make it snow...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I have just the device.
All I'd have to do is make some minor adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet the children would love that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
